63	## Task B — polarized 1×1×1 leaf leak (small frustums reflecting on air:air)

65	### Symptom
66	Frustums with `frustumSize < 2` spuriously "reflect" on pure air:air
67	boundaries that should have R=0.
68	
69	### Root cause (confirmed by direct source reading, not guessed)
70	A genuine 1×1×1 (finest) octree leaf must **never** carry a polarization
71	descriptor (`NodeDescriptor.polar() != null`) — polarity is a coarse-aggregate
72	concept only (baked when a node aggregates ≥2 children of differing
73	material). Two leaks let it happen anyway:
74	
75	1. **`Branch.virtualLodCell`** (`src/main/java/dev/thedocruby/resounding/raycast/Branch.java:216-229`)
76	   copies a coarse node's descriptor **verbatim** into a synthesized virtual
77	   cell — correct when synthesizing a real LOD aggregate (`lodSize > 1`),
78	   wrong when `lodSize == 1`, because a coarse *pruned* node
79	   (`children == null`) can still have `polar() != null` even though it's
80	   being treated as homogeneous. (Root enabler, NOT to be fixed in this pass:
81	   `OctreeManager.sameAcousticCell` (~line 326) has a same-`Block`-instance
82	   shortcut that doesn't check impedance equality, so a "homogeneous" pruned
83	   node can retain a polar descriptor baked from differing materials. This is
84	   a known follow-up, out of scope here.)
85	2. **`Cast.getBlock`** (`src/main/java/dev/thedocruby/resounding/raycast/Cast.java`,
86	   ~lines 865-880) has an early return `if (branch.size > 1) return branch;`
87	   which hands back the raw coarse (possibly polarized) branch directly,
88	   bypassing the single-material `liveLeaf(...)` resolution the rest of the
89	   method already computes unconditionally. **This is the dominant path**:
90	   the live-leaf override at `Cast.java` ~line 189
91	   (`if (lodBranch.size == 1) { Branch live = getBlock(normalized); ... }`)
92	   always fires when `requestedLod == 1` (i.e., whenever `frustumSize < 2`),
93	   so `getBlock`'s bug is what actually leaks polarity into small frustums in
94	   practice.
95	
96	`Branch.getAtLod(pos, 1)` itself always returns a size-1 node (real leaf or
97	virtual) — it's not the source of the bug. `Cast.finest = tree.get(queryPos)`
98	(~line 186) is currently only used for the `virtualLod` debug flag, not
99	guaranteed size-1 either.
100	
101	### The fix (two prongs + one guard, no other files touched)

103	1. **`Branch.virtualLodCell`**: when `lodSize == 1`, do **not** copy
104	   `descriptor` verbatim — bake a genuine single-material leaf descriptor

106	   already uses (~`Branch.java:339-342`): `imp = material.impedance()` →
107	   `new NodeDescriptor(imp, imp, imp, NaN, null)` (or `EMPTY` when material is
108	   null). Keep verbatim copy behavior for `lodSize > 1` (real LOD aggregation
109	   must be unaffected — this is directly tested, see below).
110	2. **`Cast.getBlock`**: delete the `if (branch.size > 1) return branch;`
111	   early return — always return `liveLeaf(block, shape, mat, state)`; those
112	   values are already computed unconditionally earlier in the method, so this
113	   costs nothing extra. (Bonus: this also incidentally fixes a latent bug
114	   where `resolveShape(branch)` on a coarse branch reads shape geometry from
115	   `branch.start`, a different block than the one actually queried.)
116	3. **Guard** (defensive, add near `Cast.java:296` where
117	   `Branch.NodeDescriptor branchDescriptor = branch.descriptor;` is read):
118	   `assert emissionCast || cellSize > 1 || branchDescriptor.polar() == null : "1³ cell resolved a polarized descriptor";`
119	
120	**Do not touch the N/E/D forward-survey code** (`FrustumLod.classify`,
121	`Cast.surveyForward`, the `cellSize > 1` guard around `Cast.java:399-403`).

183	## Task C — dual-derived polarity alignment
184	
185	### Requirement (verbatim from the project owner)
186	"If a beam/frustum/ray enters mostly aligned with polarity, but near the
187	point on the cube where the tangent line is, it should be treated as ~halfway
188	between the two. Basically, get the average vector of (`<incident point <->
189	center of octant>` + `<incident angle>`) / 2 (the mean) before running the
190	polarity alignment calculation." **Approved as-is, no changes requested.**
191	
192	### Current implementation
193	`Physics.polarAlignment(Vec3d rayNorm, Vec3d polNorm)`
194	(`src/main/java/dev/thedocruby/resounding/Physics.java:42-45`) is purely
195	`dot = rayNorm·polNorm; return dot*dot` — two direction vectors in, no
196	position/octant context. Three call sites in `Cast.raycast()` (one method
197	body, lines ~172-447), all of which already have `pposition` (incident
198	point), `cellBase` (octant min corner), and `cellSize` (octant edge length)
199	in local scope with **zero new plumbing required**:
200	- `Cast.java:302` — `polarizedImpedance(branchDescriptor, vector)` → internal
201	  `polarBlendWeight(descriptor, vector)` (`Cast.java:528-541`) →
202	  `Physics.polarAlignment(vector.normalize(), pol.normalize())` at
203	  `Cast.java:540`. Feeds `Physics.blendImpedance`, which sets `newImpedance`
204	  — **this affects real R/T physics, not just cosmetics.**
205	- `Cast.java:353` — same `polarBlendWeight(branchDescriptor, vector)`, feeds
206	  the notable-interaction/commit-reflect gate (`Cast.java:342-371`).
207	- `Cast.java:442-444` — `this.lastPolarAlignment = Physics.polarAlignment(...)`,
208	  feeds `FrustumLod.nextFrustumSize`'s growth/shrink blend.
209	
210	### Approved design
211	
212	**Sign, resolved definitively**: `octantCenter - incidentPoint`, normalized
213	— pointing **inward**, from the crossing point toward the cell center. Proof
214	by limit cases (both confirmed by exact closed-form arithmetic, not just
215	intuition):
216	- Dead-center entry (ray aimed straight at center): `C - P` is parallel to
217	  the ray → blend is a no-op → alignment equals the current pure-angle
218	  result, unchanged. (The reversed sign `P - C` degenerates to the zero
219	  vector exactly in this case — proof the sign must be `C - P`.)
220	- Tangent entry with a fully pol-aligned ray: `C - P` is nearly perpendicular
221	  to the ray; the normalized sum is the exact angular bisector, 45° off the
222	  ray. Alignment becomes `cos²45° = exactly 0.5` — precisely the "~halfway"
223	  spec, with no fudge factor needed.
224	- Degenerate guard: if `(C - P)` has `lengthSquared() < 1e-12`, or the sum
225	  `rayNorm + normalize(C-P)` has `lengthSquared() < 1e-12`, fall back to raw
226	  `normalize(rayNorm)`.
227	
228	**API** — add to `Physics.java`, alongside `polarAlignment` (do **not**
229	change `polarAlignment`'s existing signature; it's tested and stays as the
230	final-stage primitive):
231	
232	```java
233	/** Blended "effective ray norm": normalize(rayNorm + normalize(octantCenter - incidentPoint)).
234	 *  Falls back to normalize(rayNorm) when either the offset or the sum is degenerate. */
235	public static Vec3d dualDerivedNorm(@NotNull Vec3d rayNorm, @NotNull Vec3d incidentPoint, @NotNull Vec3d octantCenter)
236	
237	/** polarAlignment(dualDerivedNorm(...), polNorm) — position-aware alignment. */
238	public static double dualDerivedAlignment(@NotNull Vec3d rayNorm, @NotNull Vec3d incidentPoint, @NotNull Vec3d octantCenter, @NotNull Vec3d polNorm)
239	```
240	
241	`dualDerivedNorm` should normalize `rayNorm` internally (don't rely on
242	call sites pre-normalizing). Implement as sum-then-normalize (mathematically
243	identical to average-then-normalize).
244	
245	**Uniform application**: apply at **all three** call sites (302, 353,
246	442-444) — the impedance-blend and reflect/permeate-gate sites must never
247	disagree with each other (they currently share one `w`), and the frustum-
248	growth telemetry site must reflect the same formula for debugging to make
249	sense. One helper, three call sites:
250	- Compute `Vec3d octantCenter = cellBase.add(cellSize * 0.5, cellSize * 0.5, cellSize * 0.5)`
251	  once in `raycast()` after `cellBase`/`cellSize` are established.
252	- Change the private `Cast.polarBlendWeight(descriptor, vector)` →
253	  `polarBlendWeight(descriptor, vector, incidentPoint, octantCenter)`
254	  (private, no external API break), swapping its `Physics.polarAlignment`
255	  call for `Physics.dualDerivedAlignment`. `polarizedImpedance` gets the
256	  same two extra params and forwards them.
257	- Site 442-444 calls `Physics.dualDerivedAlignment(vector.normalize(), pposition, octantCenter, polar.normalize())`
258	  directly, using whatever `vector` is current at that point in the method
259	  (it may have been reassigned by `permeationBend` earlier in the same call
260	  — that's correct: post-bend alignment is what the growth blend should see).
261	
262	Existing 3 tests in `src/test/java/dev/thedocruby/resounding/PhysicsPolarBlendTest.java`
263	(lines 23, 28, 33 — bare `Vec3d` pairs into `polarAlignment`) must stay green
264	untouched, since that method's signature doesn't change.

312	## Task D — K-key focused-ray "kapture" (dead key + flash feedback)
313	
314	### Requirement (final, as corrected by the owner)
315	"Make it a dead key when nothing has been captured. Provide visual feedback
316	in the form of the ray flashing in & out of visibility (leave the frustum
317	octants rendered the whole time) 3x in 1.5s. white -> transparent -> white ->
318	transparent -> white -> transparent -> white -> no more flashing. The
319	technical direction you have [for the log-dump format] is fine."
320	
321	So: **K is a pure read** of existing `CaptureBuffer` data for the currently
322	focused ray. If empty → literally nothing happens (no arming, no warning, no
323	side effect at all — true dead key). If non-empty → log it (format below) and
324	trigger the flash.
325	
326	### Existing infra (verified, reuse as-is)
327	- Keybindings: `src/main/java/dev/thedocruby/resounding/debug/DebugKeybinds.java` —
328	  Fabric `KeyBinding` fields, polled per-tick via
329	  `ClientTickEvents.END_CLIENT_TICK.register(...)` (~line 63) with
330	  `while (BINDING.wasPressed())` loops. `B` toggles bounce-ray display; `J`
331	  calls `OctreeLayer.cycleLiveFrustumRay()`, which sets
332	  `OctreeLayer.selectedRayIndex` (int, `OctreeLayer.java:99`, exposed via
333	  `selectedRayIndex()`, `-1` = none focused). `GLFW_KEY_K` is unused.
334	- `CaptureBuffer`/`C` key: `CaptureBuffer.INSTANCE.isCapturing()` toggled by
335	  `C`. While capturing, `Renderer.addSoundBounceRay`
336	  (`src/main/java/dev/thedocruby/resounding/raycast/Renderer.java:19-51`)
337	  offers a `CaptureBuffer.CapturedRay` record (`CaptureBuffer.java:22-40`:
338	  `start, end, color, soundEventId, rayIndex, bounceIndex, material,
339	  reflectivity, transmission, power, priorImpedance, branchSize,
340	  materialLabel, terminated`) per bounce, gated on `pConfig.dRays`.
341	  `CaptureBuffer.segmentsForRayIndex(rayIndex)` returns all bounce records
342	  for one ray — this is exactly what K reads.
343	- **Key discovery**: the focused ray is **already rendered as a solid white
344	  overlay** — `ACTIVE_RAY_COLOR = 0xFFFFFFFF` (`BounceRayLayer.java:27`) via
345	  `renderFocusedWhiteRay()` → `renderActiveRay()`
346	  (`BounceRayLayer.java:113-125, 158-179`), on a dedicated no-depth-test
347	  buffer, completely separate from `OctreeLayer`'s octant-box rendering (own
348	  layer/buffers). So "flash" = literally toggling whether this existing
349	  render call happens, not a recolor. `OctreeLayer` is untouched by any of
350	  this — octant boxes keep rendering the whole time, automatically, since
351	  nothing here changes `OctreeLayer` at all.

355	### Approved design

358	fields (unconditional, benefits regular `C`-capture too — no parallel
359	record type, avoids duplicating the offer plumbing):

361	- `double polarAlignment` — `cast.lastPolarAlignment`
362	- `double frustumSize` — `cast.frustumSize`
363	- `@Nullable String blankReason` — `cast.lastBlankReason == NONE ? null : cast.lastBlankReason.name()`
364	- `boolean shapeMode` — `cast.lastShapeMode`

366	To populate these without blowing out `Renderer.addSoundBounceRay`'s
367	positional-param count, change that method to accept the `Cast` object
368	directly (already in scope at its call site,
369	`Engine.emitDebugSegment`/`Engine.java:582`) and snapshot fields inside

372	**Log format** — new small class `src/main/java/dev/thedocruby/resounding/debug/KaptureLogger.java`,
373	static `dump(int rayIndex, List<CapturedRay> bounces)`, one
374	`Utils.LOGGER.info` per bounce (not one multi-line blob — matches existing
375	grep-ability), framed by a header/footer line:
376	```
377	Resounding KAPTURE ray #{rayIndex} sound={soundEventId} bounces={n} ---
378	Resounding KAPTURE: ray #{} bounce #{} node={}³ mode={SHAPE|VOXEL} start={pos} end={pos} material={label|?} Zprev=%.1f Z=%.1f R=%.3f T=%.3f power=%.1f polar=%.3f frustum=%.2f[ blank={reason}][ TERMINATED]
